items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Every time you got to a session with Bernard Purdie, he goes to set up his little placards in the window, talking about “Hitmaker.”

ctx.x: Last time I saw Purdie, it was in Detroit. We were doing the jazz festival in Detroit. He was with his little niece or somebody, some girl with him. That was the last time I saw him. Every time you got to a session with Bernard Purdie, he goes to set up his little placards in the window, talking about “Hitmaker.” Did you know that?
